answer: Your records do not list any allergies. The allergy list in your record is empty, and nothing in your medical history or notes mentions an allergy or a reaction to a medicine. That does not fully rule out an allergy, because an allergy may never have been written down. If you know you react badly to a medicine, food or other substance, tell your doctor or pharmacist so it can be added to your record. Check this before you are given a new medicine.
